scripts.test: npm run test:desktop && npm run test --workspace web && npm run test:rust
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.build: cargo build -p life-board-api --locked && npm run build:app
scripts.package: cargo build -p life-board-api --release --locked && npm run build:app && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: cargo build -p life-board-api --release --locked && npm run build:app && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: cargo build -p life-board-api --release --locked && npm run build:app && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: cargo build -p life-board-api --release --locked && npm run build:app && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never -c.directories.output=release/mac-x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: cargo build -p life-board-api --release --locked && npm run build:app && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.directories.output=release/mac-arm64
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:app && cargo build -p life-board-api --locked --features e2e --target-dir target/e2e && node desktop/scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:debug: npm run build:app && cargo build -p life-board-api --locked --features e2e --target-dir target/e2e && node desktop/scripts/run-e2e.mjs --debug
scripts.demo:record: npm run build:app && cargo build -p life-board-api --locked --features e2e --target-dir target/e2e && node desktop/scripts/run-e2e.mjs --config playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.test:backend:coverage: npm run test:desktop && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage:ci: npm run test:coverage --workspace api && npm run test:coverage --workspace web && vitest run --config desktop/vitest.config.ts --coverage
scripts.benchmark:ci: npm run benchmark:api && npm run benchmark:web
